rationale: The workflow already applies the dependency-caching optimization: both jobs use astral-sh/setup-uv@v7 with enable-cache: true and cache-dependency-glob: "uv.lock", which caches uv-downloaded dependencies keyed to the lockfile. This satisfies P-LIT-GHA-CACHE, whose contraindication "an equivalent cache already exists" applies, so adding another cache would be redundant. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST is not warranted because GitHub Actions defaults fail-fast to true and the matrix outcomes (format, gitlint, lint, mypy across Python versions; pytest variants across OSes) are all required checks, so canceling remaining matrix cells could hide required results. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT lacks a precondition: the CI history records only conclusions, no job durations, so a safe custom timeout cannot be derived from representative history. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because the workflow triggers on version tags (*.*.*) that may represent release work, and canceling superseded runs could affect release-related checks. No change preserves the intended build and test coverage without introducing unsupported or risky behavior.
